import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import warnings
import xgboost as xgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")


# Enhanced text preprocessing: aggressive cleaning + noise patterns
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text)
    # Remove surrounding quotes
    text = text.strip('"').strip()
    # Normalize escapes
    text = text.replace("\\n", " ").replace("\\r", " ").replace("\\t", " ")
    # Remove URLs
    text = re.sub(r"http[s]?://\S+", "", text)
    # Remove repeated characters (e.g., "cooool" → "cool")
    text = re.sub(r"(.)\1{2,}", r"\1\1", text)
    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    # Keep letters, numbers, basic punctuation
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9\s\.\,\!\?\:\;\-\']", " ", text)
    return text.lower()


train_df["cleaned_comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["cleaned_comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)


# Extract temporal features
def extract_time_features(date_str):
    if pd.isna(date_str) or str(date_str).strip() == "":
        return [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    try:
        s = str(date_str).replace("Z", "").strip()
        if len(s) < 14:
            return [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
        year = int(s[0:4])
        month = int(s[4:6])
        day = int(s[6:8])
        hour = int(s[8:10])
        minute = int(s[10:12])
        second = int(s[12:14])
        from datetime import datetime

        dt = datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, second)
        return [hour / 23.0, dt.weekday() / 6.0, day / 31.0]
    except:
        return [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]


train_time = np.vstack(train_df["Date"].apply(extract_time_features).values)
test_time = np.vstack(test_df["Date"].apply(extract_time_features).values)


# Create word-shape features
def word_shape_features(text):
    text = str(text)
    words = text.split()
    if not words:
        return [0.0] * 7
    total_upper = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper())
    total_chars = len(text) if text else 1
    excl_count = text.count("!")
    quest_count = text.count("?")
    caps_ratio = total_upper / total_chars
    excl_ratio = excl_count / len(words)
    quest_ratio = quest_count / len(words)
    avg_word_len = np.mean([len(w) for w in words]) if words else 0
    profanity_patterns = len(
        re.findall(
            r"\b(fuck|shit|damn|bitch|ass| cunt |dick|piss)\b", text, re.IGNORECASE
        )
    )
    return [
        caps_ratio,
        excl_ratio,
        quest_ratio,
        avg_word_len,
        excl_count,
        quest_count,
        profanity_patterns,
    ]


train_word_shape = np.vstack(
    train_df["cleaned_comment"].apply(word_shape_features).values
)
test_word_shape = np.vstack(
    test_df["cleaned_comment"].apply(word_shape_features).values
)


# Linguistic pattern features for insults
def linguistic_pattern_features(text):
    text_lower = str(text).lower()
    words = text_lower.split()
    word_count = len(words) if words else 1

    # Second-person address patterns
    second_person = len(re.findall(r"\b(you|your|u|ur|y\'all)\b", text_lower))

    # Address markers (honorifics, nicknames)
    address_markers = len(
        re.findall(r"\b(dude|sir|miss|mr\.?|mrs\.?|ms\.?|boss)\b", text_lower)
    )

    # Comparative/superlative degradation
    degradation = len(
        re.findall(
            r"\b(worst|worst\b|better\s+than|more\s+than|less\s+than)\b", text_lower
        )
    )

    # Imperative constructions
    imperative = len(re.findall(r"\b(shut|go|get|be|do|have|make)\b", text_lower))

    # Direct address patterns
    direct_address = len(
        re.findall(r"\byou\b\s+(are|\'re|a|an|the|idiot|loser|dumb|stupid)", text_lower)
    )

    return [
        second_person,
        second_person / word_count,
        address_markers,
        address_markers / word_count,
        degradation,
        imperative,
        direct_address,
        len(re.findall(r"\b(well\s+done|good\s+job|great\s+work)\b", text_lower)) > 0,
    ]


train_linguistic = np.vstack(
    train_df["Comment"].apply(linguistic_pattern_features).values
)
test_linguistic = np.vstack(
    test_df["Comment"].apply(linguistic_pattern_features).values
)


# Profanity concentration features
def profanity_concentration_features(text):
    text_lower = str(text).lower()
    text_cleaned = clean_text(text)
    word_count = len(text_cleaned.split()) if text_cleaned.strip() else 1
    char_count = len(text_cleaned) if text_cleaned else 1

    profanity_tokens = len(
        re.findall(
            r"\b(fuck|shit|damn|bitch|ass| cunt |dick|piss|crap|wtf|fucking|fucked)\b",
            text_lower,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )
    )

    profanity_per_word = profanity_tokens / max(word_count, 1)
    profanity_per_char = profanity_tokens / max(char_count, 1)

    high_intensity = 1.0 if profanity_per_word > 0.1 else 0.0
    extreme_intensity = 1.0 if profanity_per_word > 0.2 else 0.0

    return [
        profanity_tokens,
        profanity_per_word,
        profanity_per_char,
        high_intensity,
        extreme_intensity,
    ]


train_profanity_concentration = np.vstack(
    train_df["Comment"].apply(profanity_concentration_features).values
)
test_profanity_concentration = np.vstack(
    test_df["Comment"].apply(profanity_concentration_features).values
)


# NEW: Amplification pattern features for insult intensity
def amplification_pattern_features(text):
    text_lower = str(text).lower()
    words = text_lower.split()

    # Amplifier words
    amplifiers = [
        "so",
        "really",
        "seriously",
        "hella",
        "totally",
        "completely",
        "fucking",
        "fucking",
        "friggin",
        "frigging",
        "bloody",
        " damn",
        "bleeding",
        " bloody",
        "frackin",
        "freaking",
        "effing",
    ]

    # Negative/insult-related terms
    negative_terms = [
        "stupid",
        "idiot",
        "loser",
        "dumb",
        "pathetic",
        "worthless",
        "annoying",
        "painful",
        "horrible",
        "terrible",
        "awful",
        "bad",
        "worst",
        "useless",
        "fool",
        "sick",
        "disgusting",
        "nasty",
        "ugly",
        "hate",
        "hating",
        "crap",
        "damn",
        "shit",
        "fuck",
        "bitch",
        "ass",
        "dick",
        "piss",
    ]

    # Count amplification patterns within 2-3 words of negative terms
    amplification_count = 0
    for i, word in enumerate(words):
        if word in amplifiers:
            # Check next 2-3 words for negative terms
            for j in range(i + 1, min(i + 4, len(words))):
                if any(nt in words[j] for nt in negative_terms):
                    amplification_count += 1
                    break

    # Also count amplifiers appearing before or after negative terms
    for i, word in enumerate(words):
        if word in negative_terms:
            for j in range(max(0, i - 3), i):
                if words[j] in amplifiers:
                    amplification_count += 1
                    break

    # Binary feature: presence of strong amplification
    has_intense_amplification = 1.0 if amplification_count >= 2 else 0.0

    return [amplification_count, has_intense_amplification]


train_amplification = np.vstack(
    train_df["Comment"].apply(amplification_pattern_features).values
)
test_amplification = np.vstack(
    test_df["Comment"].apply(amplification_pattern_features).values
)

# Triple TF-IDF features
# 1. Cleaned for semantic features (word-level)
tfidf_clean = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=4000,
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.9,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    strip_accents="unicode",
)
X_train_clean = tfidf_clean.fit_transform(train_df["cleaned_comment"])
X_test_clean = tfidf_clean.transform(test_df["cleaned_comment"])

# 2. Raw TF-IDF with character-level ngrams
tfidf_raw_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=4000,
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.9,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
X_train_raw_char = tfidf_raw_char.fit_transform(train_df["Comment"])
X_test_raw_char = tfidf_raw_char.transform(test_df["Comment"])

# 3. Raw TF-IDF with word-level ngrams
tfidf_raw_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=4000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.9,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    strip_accents="unicode",
)
X_train_raw_word = tfidf_raw_word.fit_transform(train_df["Comment"])
X_test_raw_word = tfidf_raw_word.transform(test_df["Comment"])

# Combine all features
scaler_time = StandardScaler()
scaler_word_shape = StandardScaler()
train_time_scaled = scaler_time.fit_transform(train_time)
test_time_scaled = scaler_time.transform(test_time)
train_word_shape_scaled = scaler_word_shape.fit_transform(train_word_shape)
test_word_shape_scaled = scaler_word_shape.transform(test_word_shape)

X_train = hstack(
    [
        X_train_clean,
        X_train_raw_char,
        X_train_raw_word,
        csr_matrix(train_time_scaled),
        csr_matrix(train_word_shape_scaled),
        csr_matrix(train_linguistic),
        csr_matrix(train_profanity_concentration),
        csr_matrix(train_amplification),
    ]
)
X_test = hstack(
    [
        X_test_clean,
        X_test_raw_char,
        X_test_raw_word,
        csr_matrix(test_time_scaled),
        csr_matrix(test_word_shape_scaled),
        csr_matrix(test_linguistic),
        csr_matrix(test_profanity_concentration),
        csr_matrix(test_amplification),
    ]
)
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values

# Stratified train-validation split
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, stratify=y_train, random_state=42
)

# Train XGBoost
dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X_tr, label=y_tr)
dval = xgb.DMatrix(X_val, label=y_val)
watchlist = [(dtrain, "train"), (dval, "eval")]
evals_result = {}

params = {
    "objective": "binary:logistic",
    "eval_metric": "auc",
    "eta": 0.05,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "min_child_weight": 3,
    "gamma": 0.1,
    "lambda": 1.0,
    "alpha": 0.0,
    "scale_pos_weight": 1.0,
    "verbosity": 0,
    "random_state": 42,
}

model = xgb.train(
    params,
    dtrain,
    num_boost_round=500,
    evals=watchlist,
    early_stopping_rounds=50,
    evals_result=evals_result,
    verbose_eval=False,
)

# Validate on hold-out set
val_probs = model.predict(dval)
auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"AUC-ROC on validation set: {auc_score:.5f}")

# Predict on test set
dtest = xgb.DMatrix(X_test)
test_probs = model.predict(dtest)

# Create submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Comment": test_df["Comment"].values, "Insult": test_probs}
)
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
